page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance within the c3d family. It features 90 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9B14 processors using the x86_64 architecture, with 45 physical cores and 2 threads per core. The instance is equipped with 720.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 8 NVMe SSDs totaling 3216 GB. There are no GPUs present on this instance.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and PassMark CPU extended instructions tests all scoring in the top 10%. Single-core performance is strong, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core tests, though Geekbench single-core scores fall in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth is strong for read-only operations, reaching 6368.24 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 217.31 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, though large block write bandwidth is average at 77.28 GB/sec.

The combination of high memory capacity, dedicated AMD EPYC processing, and fast local NVMe storage makes this instance suitable for database operations, software compilation, and large-scale data processing. PassMark database operations and Redis SET operations both rank in the top 25%. For machine learning workloads, the instance achieves top-tier prompt processing speeds for small LLM models, but text generation speeds for larger models drop to average levels, highlighting a tradeoff when running large-scale inference without dedicated GPU acceleration.
